sites.name: Karen Organization of San Diego Food Distribution (Global Marketplace)
sites.eligibility: Everyone welcome, no registration required; first come first served, bring your own bag. Serves refugee and wider City Heights community.
sites.note: Active. Distributions at Global Marketplace (5591 University Ave) are held on announced specific dates (e.g. 10 a.m.-1 p.m.) rather than a fixed weekly recurrence; no registration required, bring your own bags. Check karensandiego.org/news-events for current dates. Main office is at 5354 University Ave. Contact Hsihsa Thaw, hsihsa@karensandiego.org.

sites.name: Holy Trinity Parish Food Bank
sites.eligibility: Open to community neighbors; must show current photo ID with an El Cajon address. One bag of staples per family per week. Distributed from main entrance of Parish Hall.
